title: Activity day
description: Time the founder spent in the venture on one day, from transcript timestamps alone, at operations/activity/<date>.json (naive activity --write). The day is the venture's IANA time zone's. Internal by default. When the calendar component is installed, activity days appear as derived events; nothing is copied there.

sessions.description: Transcript files with a founder message that day

active_minutes.description: Sum of gaps of 10 minutes or less between the founder's own messages

tokens_in.description: Estimated: characters of the founder's messages / 4

matched_by.description: How the day's sessions were matched to the venture
